question: Why are the connections between the resistors and the wire in a meter bridge made using thick metallic strips?

options.A: To provide mechanical strength to the apparatus.
options.B: To increase the resistance of the connection points.
options.C: To ensure their electrical resistance is negligible so it does not affect the balance condition.
options.D: To prevent the wire from heating up significantly.
